biotools.summary:
Nallo is a bioinformatics analysis pipeline for long-reads from both PacBio and (targeted) ONT-data, focused on rare-disease. The pipeline detects a wide range of genetic variants, performs genome assembly,
and reports CpG methylation. It also enables annotation and ranking of variants based on their predicted functional
consequences.
